coastal.title: Woman airlifted to hospital after bear attack near Whistler, B.C.
coastal.description: A woman was airlifted to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries after a bear attacked a group of hikers in the backcountry near Whistler, B.C.

coastal.title: Missing man found alive after 6-day search near Squamish, B.C.
coastal.description: A man missing near Squamish, B.C., for nearly a week has been found alive after what rescuers described as an extensive six-day search.

coastal.title: B.C. man lost for 5 nights in mountains near Squamish shares survival story
coastal.description: A Squamish man who survived a grueling five nights in British Columbia's Coast Mountains is sharing more about his experience.

coastal.title: One of the last remaining steam tugboats in Canada is heading for restoration
coastal.description: The S.S. Naramata is believed to be one of the last remaining steam fresh-water tugboats left in all of Canada. The S.S. Sicamous Marine Heritage society said the ship played a huge role in the economic development of the Okanagan Valley.

coastal.title: Woman injured in bear attack in Whistler backcountry
coastal.description: A woman was taken to hospital on Friday after a bear attack in the backcountry near Whistler.

kamloops.title: Defoliated, moth-infested trees create fire concerns for Kamloops residents
kamloops.description: Some residents of Kamloops, B.C.'s Juniper Ridge area are concerned that trees defoliated by a needle-eating moth larva could prove to be a fire hazard.

kamloops.title: Regulator suspends B.C Realtor's licence, cites 'urgent circumstances'
kamloops.description: British Columbia's superintendent of real estate has suspended the licence of a Metro Vancouver Realtor and her personal real estate corporation.

kamloops.title: Northern B.C. community brings back dinosaur mascot from extinction, after a nearly 30-year 'sabbatical'
kamloops.description: The District of Hudson's Hope unveiled a new costume for the town's mascot, Dudley the Dinosaur, last week. Kelsey Shewfelt, the recreation co-ordinator for the district, says the public has been asking to see Dudley return for years.

all.title: Critic calls on B.C. to salvage more wildfire-burned timber, province says that's 'unrealistic.' Here's why
all.description: Kamloops-North Thompson MLA Ward Stamer is calling for the province’s salvage rate to rise to 25 per cent and for more efficient access to wildfire-damaged timber.
